what_to_watch.title: Keep Castle in control
what_to_watch.text: Castle led the Sacramento win with 28 points, 11 assists and eight rebounds, committing just two turnovers. Watch whether he can keep creating good shots as the road trip moves to Portland.

what_to_watch.title: Finish possessions on the glass
what_to_watch.text: Kornet supplied 18 points and 11 rebounds against the Kings. Portland's Donovan Clingan averages 11.3 rebounds this season; watch whether the Spurs can limit second chances and turn stops into possessions.

what_to_watch.title: Let the lineup set the context
what_to_watch.text: Wembanyama, Fox and Harper all missed the Sacramento game. Check the confirmed availability for Portland before assuming the same rotation; watch how San Antonio shares the creation and protects the rim with the lineup it has.

what_to_watch.title: Keep Castle creating
what_to_watch.text: Castle had 21 points, 12 assists and four steals against the Clippers, alongside eight turnovers. Watch whether he can keep creating good looks while cutting down the giveaways.

what_to_watch.title: Make Wemby's touches count
what_to_watch.text: Wembanyama followed his 25-point, 18-rebound Detroit game with 32 points and 11 boards in the win over LA. Watch the Spurs find him inside and move the ball when extra defenders arrive.

what_to_watch.title: Protect the paint
what_to_watch.text: Zion Williamson leads New Orleans with 21.7 points per game this season. Watch how the Spurs contain drives and finish defensive possessions without leaving easy kick-out threes.

what_to_watch.title: Find points without Harper
what_to_watch.text: The Spurs scored 93 in the Detroit loss, and Harper is out with left hip soreness. Watch how Fox, Castle and Vassell share the creation and find clean shots against the Clippers.

what_to_watch.title: Keep Garland off his spots
what_to_watch.text: Darius Garland leads the Clippers with 21.2 points and 6.9 assists per game. Watch the Spurs navigate his screens and recover to shooters without giving up easy drives.

what_to_watch.title: Build on Wemby's work
what_to_watch.text: Wembanyama had 25 points and 18 rebounds against Detroit. Watch whether San Antonio can pair that interior presence with better perimeter shooting after going 9-for-40 from three in the loss.

what_to_watch.title: Make Wemby's size count
what_to_watch.text: With Jalen Duren out, watch whether Wembanyama can turn his size into paint touches and second chances. Detroit's replacement frontcourt still has to be beaten on the glass.

what_to_watch.title: Make Cade work for it
what_to_watch.text: Cade Cunningham leads Detroit with 25.7 points and 7.9 assists per game. Watch the Spurs' guards navigate screens and recover to shooters without giving him a clear path to the rim.

what_to_watch.title: Keep the streak moving
what_to_watch.text: The Spurs enter with 12 straight wins. Harper's 31 points helped finish the job in Utah; watch whether San Antonio can create good shots throughout the rotation and make it 13.
